In 1885, a German scientist named Hermann Ebbinghaus did something strange.
He memorized lists of made-up nonsense words.
Then he tested himself, again and again, to see how fast he'd forget them.
Within a day, most of it was gone.
It's why rereading your notes the night before doesn't stick.
What does stick? Short reviews, and testing yourself.
The rereading. The rewriting. The flashcards.
Drop in any PDF, notes, or slides.
Unspool turns it into short reels, with a quiz at the end.
